predictions.source_summary: Fallback assignment when no memcache configuration is found in main config or memcache.conf file
predictions.sink_summary: MemcacheRing constructor that creates socket connections to memcache servers for caching operations
predictions.guard_summary: Configuration lookup hierarchy: 1) main config 'memcache_servers', 2) memcache.conf file, 3) hardcoded default. No validation of server addresses.
predictions.risk_pattern: Hardcoded localhost default creates single point of failure and potential cache poisoning if external memcache server is expected but not configured
predictions.context_summary: Middleware that provides caching functionality to Swift object storage. The memcache is used throughout the system via env['swift.cache'] for various caching operations including potentially authentication/authorization data.

top_sast_rules.description: Extracting files from a potentially malicious tarball using `shutil.unpack_archive()` without validating that the destination file path is within the destination directory can cause files outside the destination directory to be overwritten. top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement path validation using canonical paths. Reject paths containing '../' or similar traversal sequences.
